outcome.spec:
Audit the live-verification work already on pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/771. This is an isolated verification run of the committed development definition, not new feature implementation. Produce one cohort named slice in repository oakridge. Preserve two run-unique criterion IDs: criterion-lineage for capture provenance and criterion-export for authenticated stored-record readback. Use decision-capture for the decision to preserve the production publisher wire payloads and use authenticated HTTP response bodies. Both criteria must cite decision-capture, and retain the same IDs in the brief and assessment.
The builder must inspect and test the existing live-verification changes, publish actual test counts and any gaps, and publish the existing PR #771 as the pr artifact (branch cohort/live-verification/bc33be). The assessor must assess the existing code and publish factual findings linked to these criteria. Do not edit code, create commits, push or create a new PR, merge anything, reset any database or deploy. Existing failures and absent live credentials are findings, not reasons to invent passing evidence. Keep the analysis/spec/tasks/plan/brief concise; there are no ambiguous requirements to resolve. Plan-wide acceptance_criteria may be ordinary text per the declared schema. The purposes are a real newly produced plan/brief/assessment and production capture; no pre-existing observation fixtures may be used as artifact bodies. For this isolated verification cohort, these instructions override the generic development builder prompt: do not commit, push, or open a PR; publish build_result first, then publish existing PR #771 on cohort/live-verification/bc33be.
For criterion-lineage, inspect the live source capture launcher and v2 provenance validation. For criterion-export, inspect tenant-scoped question/evidence API routes and direct provider readback. Actual grading is performed after this source run. A capture need not claim a provider grade already occurred. The separately recorded gated-review server invalid-token acceptance is an open upstream issue, not an authorization to change that server.
Run only focused audit checks in this verification cohort: the gated-review tools smoke test, workflow-config definitions tests, and observation grading-records/direct-provider tests. Run the named focused checks against the exact PR head being audited. If that head cannot be used as the audit checkout, or a named file is absent there, record the gap and do not substitute an unbounded suite. Report the checked-out commit and PR head separately. Publish build_result first, then the existing pr artifact. The sole purpose is real source artifact publication and honest evidence; do not expand into feature implementation.

tasks.description: Produce exactly one oakridge cohort named slice whose plan and complete brief preserve criterion-lineage, criterion-export, and decision-capture; make both criteria cite decision-capture and carry the criterion IDs unchanged into assessment.

Through gated-review, confirm the current status and head of existing PR #771 on cohort/live-verification/bc33be immediately before factual publication, audit that exact PR-head snapshot when possible, and report the checked-out commit separately from the PR head without changing source history.

Inspect the live source capture launcher for exact production publisher wire-payload capture and inspect current-definition v2 provenance validation for criterion-lineage; use a new production capture and no pre-existing observation fixture as an artifact body.

Inspect the authenticated tenant-scoped question/evidence API routes and direct-provider HTTP response-body readback for criterion-export, distinguishing capture evidence from any claim that provider grading already occurred.

Against the exact audited PR head, run only the gated-review tools smoke test, workflow-config definitions tests, and observation grading-records/direct-provider tests; publish exact pass, failure, and skip counts and record unavailable checkout, absent files, missing credentials, or other gaps without broad-suite substitution.

Publish the builder's honest build_result first, then publish the existing PR #771 as the pr artifact; override the generic builder workflow by making no edits, commits, pushes, new PRs, merges, database resets, deployments, or gated-review server changes.

Assess the existing PR code factually against criterion-lineage and criterion-export, retaining both criterion IDs and linking the findings to the evidence actually produced, including failures, skips, credential gaps, and absent files.

body.summary: The verification is implementable without code changes, but the operator should account for two repository-contract mismatches before planning: this analysis worktree is at 8a215298f59bffd27216f6b637876494df2bf324 while PR #771 is open at 1954f8ab91a35843845f777799d4ae8b7c29e14d, and the committed generic builder prompt instructs a push/new PR plus pr-before-build_result, opposite to this verification specification. At the PR head, the requested criterion surfaces exist: live-source-run.ts retains exact production publisher deliveries; jev-live-walkthrough.ts validates current-definition v2 provenance; grading-record routes enforce read credentials and tenant scope; and direct-provider verification reads question, evidence, execution, and grade records from authenticated HTTP bodies. No tests were run in analysis; the builder remains responsible for focused counts and honest skips/gaps.

findings.description: The checked-out commit is 8a215298f59bffd27216f6b637876494df2bf324 on oakridge/73876c20cd06788c. Gated-review reports PR #771 open on cohort/live-verification/bc33be at 1954f8ab91a35843845f777799d4ae8b7c29e14d, based on epic/land-grading. The PR objects are locally available, so the required separate reporting is feasible.

The checked-out base contains workflow-config/src/definitions.test.ts and observation/tests/jev-direct.test.ts, but not the PR-added kbbl/core/acp/gated-review-tools.smoke.test.ts or observation/tests/grading-records.test.ts. Testing only files present in the current base would not test all existing PR changes. The focused checks should be evaluated against the exact PR head used for the audit; inability to make that head the audit checkout should be recorded as a gap, without substituting a broad suite.

workflow-config/prompts/development/build.md directs builders to commit, push, open a new draft PR, publish pr first, and publish build_result second. The verification specification forbids those mutations, requires the existing PR, and reverses artifact order. A verification brief must state that its no-mutation and publication-order instructions override this generic build workflow; otherwise the builder receives directly conflicting instructions.

At PR head 1954f8ab91a35843845f777799d4ae8b7c29e14d, oakridge-dbos/scripts/live-source-run.ts captures decoded SourceEventDelivery wire payloads before the real sink acknowledges them, and observation/scripts/jev-live-walkthrough.ts rejects fixtures, requires one run of the current committed development definition, and validates observation.artifact-revision/v2 provenance.

At the PR head, observation/src/http/grading-records.ts requires read credentials for question-version and evidence-set reads, storage lookups apply producer/namespace tenant scope, and the direct-provider walkthrough verifies unauthenticated refusal plus authenticated HTTP response-body equality and provenance.

The focused live checks intentionally depend on credentials and services: gated-review role tokens and server reachability, OAKRIDGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL, a new production capture, installed ACP authentication, and TYPESAFE_API_KEY for provider grading. The specification correctly treats missing prerequisites and the recorded invalid-token acceptance as factual gaps rather than passing evidence or authorization to change the upstream server.
